text:
Clara (Finance): Recon alert: 31 Stripe payments show as succeeded but no NetSuite invoice. Saw this at 07:20 UTC. Can payments/ops take a look?

Eli (Payments): Checking Stripe delivery logs now. Any recent changes to billing-sync/webhooks?

netsuite-bot: ALERT: /webhooks/netsuite delivery failures 07:12:10 - 07:26:03 UTC. Failed events: 31. Error breakdown: 24 x SignatureVerificationError, 7 x UpstreamHTTP(500). See /ops/webhooks/alerts/1742670007

Zoe (Backend): We rotated NETSUITE_WEBHOOK_SECRET at 07:05 during a deploy and tightened timestamp tolerance to 120s. Logs show rejected events with "SignatureVerificationError: timestamp outside tolerance" starting ~07:13.

Nico (Ops): I missed updating the Stripe endpoint signing secret. Re-applying previous secret to verifier and restarting billing-sync now, will keep previous secret available for 12h.

Eli (Payments): Example event evt_6XYzAb - invoice.payment_succeeded, metadata.external_ref="INV-2026-04-07-59". Pushed a sample to backfill queue.

Zoe (Backend): I'll push a small hotfix to accept current+previous signing secrets for 24h and change retry logic: treat NetSuite 409 externalId as idempotent and GET existing instead of retrying create. Deploying now.

netsuite-bot: DEPLOY: billing-sync v2.20.1-hotfix by Zoe at 07:31 UTC. Health checks passing.

Nico (Ops): Opened NS ticket NS-10245 for partial create cleanup and asked NetSuite to unlock external_id values for safe retry.

Clara (Finance): Please export exceptions CSV: stripe_event, external_ref, customer_email, amount_cents, currency, stripe_status and share with CS. Also need a short impact summary for postmortem.

Eli (Payments): CSV saved to /finance/recon/ops/1742670007-missing_invoices.csv. Holding backfill until NetSuite confirms cleanup for partials.

Zoe (Backend): Backfill plan: dedupe by stripe_event_id, create -> on 409 GET existing, on 5xx flag for manual review. Will run once NetSuite clears partials. Posting postmortem draft after resolution.

Clara (Finance): Thanks. Triage note: payments were captured in Stripe for all events, customer-facing impact = missing invoice PDFs. Please notify CS with the CSV and update this thread when backfill completes. :thumbsup:
